card.name: The s ending on decades and round numbers
card.fires_on: The plural ending s (or 's) attached to a number such as 1980′, 1600′ or 900, and the word after a tens number like Twenty or Thirty. It marks decades, centuries or approximate counts.

modes.label: Decade or century plural
modes.description: The s ending directly after a year or round number, often with an apostrophe.
modes.example: Because of the influence of rock on worship songs from 1980′<<s>> to present, a bridge is often included

modes.label: Twenty/Thirty-something
modes.description: A word like something or -some right after a tens number, meaning an approximate age.
modes.example: Quarter-life crisis - Twenty<< something>> - Thirty something - Young professional

modes.label: Number followed by a qualifier
modes.description: A word after a round number that modifies it, such as proof.
modes.example: volumes of 200<< proof>> ethanol and 0.9% Sodium

card.plain: It fires on the ending that turns a number into a decade or approximate age, like 1980s or thirty-something.
